facts.fact: SUV 跟踪——拔枪对峙：David Harper（妻儿在车上）。
facts.anchor: David Harper’s face moving into view in the gap.

facts.fact: Harper 求助：贿赂、勒索——要证人保护、今晚；行李已装车。
facts.anchor: the bribes. The blackmail. But you have to get us into witness protection. Tonight.

facts.fact: Alex 控诉：改河饿田买地重建——安排谋杀三名原告中的两名。
facts.anchor: you arranged the murder of two of the three plaintiffs on the civil suit

facts.fact: Harper 承诺：在记录上全招——为保护家人。
facts.anchor: On the record, the whole thing.

facts.fact: Keller 杀到：「他悲伤过度神志不清」——Alex：「他说的什么都是不可采的。」
Harper 盯律师十秒——温顺点头缩回车里，开车回 Dunning。
facts.anchor: He nodded meekly, stepping back toward the car without another word.

facts.fact: Keller 临别：「你有个凶手要抓。时钟在滴答。」
章末对峙：「你会自己处置凶手？」——「我干我的活。建议你也干你的。」
facts.anchor: And I suggest you do the same thing.
